_comment: OPTIONAL. Merge the PostToolUse entry below into your PROJECT-level .claude/settings.json (create the file if it doesn't exist) to enable real tool-name-level activity in the dashboard for Claude Code sessions running in this repo. The dashboard works without this — you just get coarser 'status changed' activity instead of per-tool detail. This does NOT touch or replace any existing user-level hooks (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json) — project-level and user-level hooks both run; adding this here does not disable anything else.
